proves.claim: The no-link page on the board's own machine names running pullboard view to print the private link and does not send the owner to someone else.

view.no-link.local-names-pullboard-view.why: Without it the owner opening their own view could hit a dead end with no way forward.

proves.claim: The no-link page for any non-local request keeps the shared-board wording and shows no link, key or board data.

view.no-link.shared-keeps-wording-and-re.why: Without it a change for the owner could leak the local instruction or a secret to other visitors.

proves.claim: Through the served view, a loopback browser GET with no key gets 401 saying to run pullboard view, with no secret or board data.

view.serve.no-link-local-says-run-pullbo.why: Without it the wording could be right in the page function yet never reach the owner through the real server.
